en: Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city with dense, red‑roofed buildings seen from an elevated, green hillside. A prominent church-like structure with a steep, pointed roof appears on the left, and a grand civic building with ornate façade is visible near the center. The lower margin has printed German captions and publisher information, with handwritten cursive text across the bottom.
